text:
Maya CSM: FYI prepping QBR for account NIGHTWAVE — noticed a sudden jump in embed token burn linked to their onboarding scripts. Need a concise slide: root cause, forecast, recommended immediate mitigations.

Diego (FinOps): pulling commit + usage. Can do baseline + two uplift scenarios. Also flag renewal window in 28 days; recommend a mitigation SLA to avoid overage conversation.

Rina (Enablement): I'll create a 1-slide checklist for customer to adopt batching + KV prefix caching and note expected uplift reduction.

Maya CSM: @Arjun any infra telemetry on whether this is from a new route or an increase on existing endpoints?

Arjun Eng: looks like majority of tokens from the new "embed/bulk" endpoint. Traces show parallel requests without batching header. Deployed a safe guard rule to limit concurrent bulk requests to 10 for now.

deploy-bot: Billing alert: NIGHTWAVE crossed 70% monthly allocation (alert id bw-9921).

Maya CSM: Action list: 1) Arjun 1: add short-term concurrency cap (done). 2) Diego 1: slide with baseline/expected/worst-case by EOD. 3) Rina 1: embed best-practices sheet + one-liner for the QBR handout. 4) I'll draft customer outreach proposing a mitigation call and soft throttle.

Diego (FinOps): quick numbers: 30d: 910k tokens, 7d: 420k tokens, commit: 1,000k. If current rate holds, projected month-end ~1.6M (60% over commit). With batching applied to top 3 routes, projection drops to ~780k. Recommend proposing a 15% credits buffer in renewal packet.

Rina (Enablement): checklist draft: enable batching header, set max_batch_size=64, use async queueing, enable KV prefix caching for similar inputs, reduce vector dims where possible. I'll attach a short example snippet for Node and Python.

Arjun Eng: added telemetry tag to bulk requests so we can track adopt rate of batching. Will pull an adoption report for QBR.

Maya CSM: Good. I'll include a "cost mitigation" appendix in the QBR showing before/after chart and an ask to add a temporary rate-limit until batching adoption reaches 50%. Posting a draft in #customer-comm for review.

Diego (FinOps): I'll include sensitivity table (5%, 15%, 30% uplift) and a recommended soft-throttle threshold.

deploy-bot: Billing alert resolved: usage trending down after concurrency cap.

Maya CSM: Thanks everyone 1. Closing loop once Diego uploads slides and Rina's checklist is attached. If billing alert reappears, I'll escalate immediately.
